basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast and a huge fan of VR gaming, residing in the US. I'm a stay-at-home parent who loves catching up on my favorite TV shows like 'Desperate Housewives' and 'Agents of SHIELD' during my downtime. I dabble in freelance writing and often participate in online surveys to earn some extra cash. Most of my online activity happens in the late evenings, once the kids are asleep. Married for over a decade, I enjoy balancing family life with my passion for technology.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in consumer technology, mostly self-taught through years of exploring gadgets and participating in tech forums. I also have a bachelor's degree in computer science, which has sharpened my analytical skills, though much of my current knowledge comes from staying updated with the latest tech news and trends.
